notes.title: Development Log: 🦅 A Sacred Bond
notes.content: [h2]🦅 Development Log: A Sacred Bond[/h2][p]For centuries, [b]eagles and hawks[/b] have played an important role in hunting traditions around the world:[/p][list][*][p]In [b]Mongolia[/b], golden eagles were trained to hunt foxes and hares in the harsh steppes.[/p][/*][*][p]In [b]Turkey and Central Asia[/b], falconry became a symbol of skill and status, passed down through generations.[/p][/*][*][p]For [b]Indigenous tribes in North America[/b], birds of prey were not only hunting partners but also sacred beings, guides, and a vital source of life.[/p][/*][/list][p]These traditions were born out of the need to survive in unforgiving environments, but they also carried a [b]spiritual meaning[/b]. The bond between hunter and bird represented [b]trust, respect, and harmony with nature[/b].[/p][p]With the [b]Eagle Companion[/b], we want players to feel that same bond — not just a companion who fights by your side, but a true partner who helps you track, hunt, and survive.[/p][h3]With this special partner, you can:[/h3][list][*][p]Hunt small animals — for example, command your eagle to catch a snake and bring it back.[/p][/*][*][p]Take direct control of the eagle, using it almost like a [b]drone[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Use its [b]thermal vision[/b] to sense nearby dangers or spot wildlife.[/p][/*][/list][p]The eagle is not just a visual companion; it will be a [b]vital support in your struggle for survival[/b].[/p][previewyoutube="xNz6VtzRBH4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]

notes.title: 🔥 New Mechanic: MELTING FURNACE is Here! 🧱⚒️
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="F34CNJ-Kf8k;full"][/previewyoutube][p]🔥 [b]New Mechanic: MELTING FURNACE is Here![/b] 🧱⚒️
[b]Hey Hunters![/b] 👋
A brand new crafting mechanic has arrived: the [b]Melting Furnace![/b] 🏭[/p][p]🛠️ [b]What does this furnace do?[/b]
This manually-built furnace allows you to [b]melt previously crafted stones 🪨 and ores ⛓️ into metal ingots![/b] 🔥[/p][p]🔩 These ingots will play a key role in crafting [b]advanced tools, weapons, and many other essential items[/b] as you progress through the game! 💎[/p][p]🎯 In short:
1️⃣ Gather your resources
2️⃣ Craft and place your furnace
3️⃣ Melt stone and ore
4️⃣ Use the ingots to craft new items![/p][p]⛓️ With this addition, the crafting system becomes deeper and even more satisfying, adding a new layer of realism and progression![/p][p]📌 Don’t miss out on updates like this:
👉 Add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b]
👉 [b]Follow us[/b] to stay up-to-date on all upcoming features![/p]

notes.title: 🔧 New Mechanic: The GRINDER Machine is Here! ⚙️
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257506/7bc4ad49aadd98dbda36d2745a237ce82ae51fce.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🔧 New Mechanic: The GRINDER Machine is Here! ⚙️[/b]
[b]Hey Hunters! 👋[/b]
Our crafting system keeps evolving! 🚀 A brand new mechanic has just been added: the [b]GRINDER[/b]! 💥[/p][p][b]🛠️ So, what does this machine do?[/b]
You drop your stones 🪨 and metals ⛓️ into the GRINDER, and it turns them into small, useful parts! 🔩[/p][p]🎯 With these parts, you can now craft:
🧷 Metal Arrows
🪶 Stone Arrows
...and many more items! 🧰[/p][p]🌀 Set up the machine, insert your materials, grind them down, and start crafting!
The crafting system is getting deeper, and the foundations of survival are getting stronger! 🧱[/p][p]📌 Don’t miss out on this and many other upcoming features:
👉 Add our game to your wishlist
👉 Follow us to be the first to know![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_Gu6YKIXHgk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][previewyoutube="fRRmjTbd1Lo;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 🪵 New Craft Mechanic: Log Cutter is here! 🔧🔥
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257506/852c9a34b8efbaa1e772c7471262ed4b9b1816bf.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🪵 New Craft Mechanic: Log Cutter is here! 🔧🔥[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Hey hunters! 👋[/p][p]Log Cutter, one of our newly added craft systems, is now in the game! 💪[/p][p][/p][p]🌲 Now you will get logs as you cut down trees.[/p][p]🛠️ You will be able to turn these logs into sticks by placing them in our hand-powered Log Cutter machine![/p][p]🔥 Use the sticks you produce as craft materials or keep your fire alive as fuel![/p][p][/p][p]🚧 This system will be completely manual. You will have to turn the machine by hand to operate the mechanism. Realism? ✔️ Labor? ✔️ Satisfying feeling? ✔️✔️✔️[/p][p][/p][p]💬 Don't forget to share your feedback and ideas with us![/p][p][/p][p]🏕️ Produce, work, move forward to survive![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Wv9kPSSL2-s;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]

notes.title: Game Development Phase
notes.content:
[p][b]🎮 Hey Hunters![/b]
After the demo release, we've been hard at work improving the overall design of the game based on your feedback. One of our main focuses has been the [b]crafting system[/b], and we’re now getting close to finalizing its core mechanics.[/p][p]🛠️ We’re planning to launch a [b]limited playtest[/b] soon, and your participation will be super valuable in helping us polish the experience. Huge thanks to everyone who's shown interest so far — your support means a lot to us![/p][p]🔥 Thanks to your continued feedback and hype, we're more motivated than ever to deliver an awesome experience.
Stay tuned — the real adventure is coming soon![/p]

notes.title: The Lost Hunter - DevLog
notes.content:
[b]“Precision Guided Bullet” Mechanics[/b]
This feature is activated at the user's discretion after shooting a certain number of animals and allows free movement in a 45 degree circle using the mouse. 

[b]Additional Information[/b]
[list]
[*] This mechanic is only activated using sniper weapons in the game.
[*] Acts in synchronization with the slow-motion bullet tracking mechanic.
[*] Activated at the user's request.
[*] After use, the counter is reset and the same number of animals must be hunted to activate the feature again
[/list]

[b]You can watch the video by clicking the Youtube link. [/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kagLViEPNdE

notes.title: The Lost Hunter - DevLog
notes.content:
Dear hunters The software development of one of our game mechanics “Hunter`s Eagle”  is nearing the end. We wanted to share a few screenshots of the mechanic with you. Feel free to share your ideas and suggestions about it.

[b]What does “Hunter`s Eagle” do?[/b]
“Hunter`s Eagle”  flies near our character and when you activate the amulet (feature), it tracks animals for you according to the feature you choose (prey animal, predator, wounded animal, dead animal). If there is an animal within hunting distance, it will fly towards it and let you know where it is.

[b]Additional Information[/b]
1: You can improve the Eagle's sphere of influence.
(100 units away, 500 units away, 1000 units away)
2: You can choose the animal the eagle should follow.
(hunting animal { like deer }, predator { like bear }, dead animal, wounded animal)
3: You can feed the eagle.
4: The eagle is always visible on the mini-map.

You can watch the video from the youtube link ːsteamthumbsupː
